name: What equipment do professionals use for toilet overflow cleanup and drying?

mainEntity.name: What equipment do professionals use for toilet overflow cleanup and drying?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professionals utilize specialized equipment to ensure thorough cleanup and drying. This includes powerful wet/dry vacuums for initial water extraction, industrial-grade air movers and fans to circulate air and evaporate moisture, and high-capacity dehumidifiers to remove humidity from the air and structural materials. They also use moisture meters and thermal imaging cameras to detect hidden moisture within walls and floors. Personal protective equipment (PPE) is also standard, especially when dealing with contaminated water, to ensure safety.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professionals use wet/dry vacuums, industrial air movers, dehumidifiers, moisture meters, and thermal cameras for cleanup and drying, along with personal protective equipment.
